artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $n\ge 2$ and $k\ge 0$ be integers, and let $\mathbb{T}^n=\mathbb{R}^n/\mathbb{Z}^n$ denote the $n$-dimensional torus. Equip the space $C^k(\mathbb{T}^n,\mathbb{T}^n)$ of $C^k$ self-maps of $\mathbb{T}^n$ with the standard $C^k$ topology, making it a Polish space.

For a continuous self-map $f:\mathbb{T}^n\to\mathbb{T}^n$, a topological factor is a continuous surjection $\pi:\mathbb{T}^n\to Y$ onto a compact metric space $Y$ together with a continuous map $g:Y\to Y$ such that $\pi\circ f=g\circ\pi$; the factor is non-trivial if $Y$ has more than one point. Say that $f$ has completely positive entropy if every non-trivial topological factor $(Y,g)$ of $f$ has positive topological entropy. Let
$$\mathrm{CPE}^k(\mathbb{T}^n)=\{f\in C^k(\mathbb{T}^n,\mathbb{T}^n): f\text{ has completely positive entropy}\}.$$
Let $\mathrm{Mix}\subset C^k(\mathbb{T}^n,\mathbb{T}^n)$ denote the set of topologically mixing self-maps, i.e. those $f$ such that for every pair of non-empty open sets $U,V\subset\mathbb{T}^n$ there exists $N$ with $f^{-m}(U)\cap V\neq\emptyset$ for all $m\ge N$.

Question: Is the set $\mathrm{CPE}^k(\mathbb{T}^n)\cap\mathrm{Mix}$ a Borel subset of $C^k(\mathbb{T}^n,\mathbb{T}^n)$?
